title.en: Install GitTree on macOS (Apple silicon and Intel)
title.ar: تثبيت GitTree على macOS (آبل سيليكون وإنتل)

promise.en: Install the universal GitTree disk image on a Mac and get past the first-launch warning.

concept: GitTree is a front end for the Git already on your computer, so Git must be installed first.

title.en: Install GitTree on Windows 10 and 11
title.ar: تثبيت GitTree على ويندوز 10 و11

promise.en: Run the GitTree setup on Windows and get past the SmartScreen warning.

concept: GitTree uses Git for Windows as its Git, and needs version 2.39 or newer.

title.en: Install GitTree on Ubuntu and Debian (.deb)
title.ar: تثبيت GitTree على أوبونتو وديبيان (حزمة deb)

promise.en: Install the .deb package with apt and start GitTree from the menu.

concept: apt resolves dependencies for a local package, and GitTree needs Git 2.39 or newer.

title.en: Run GitTree on Linux with the AppImage (no root)
title.ar: تشغيل GitTree على لينكس بصيغة AppImage دون صلاحيات root

promise.en: Make the AppImage executable and run GitTree without installing anything.

concept: A portable AppImage runs from any folder and does not register the opengittree:// link handler.

title.en: Verify a GitTree Linux download with SHA256SUMS
title.ar: التحقق من ملف GitTree على لينكس باستخدام SHA256SUMS

promise.en: Check that a downloaded installer matches the checksum published with the release.

concept: A checksum catches a corrupt download but not a compromised release.

title.en: Which Git version does GitTree need? (2.39 or newer)
title.ar: ما إصدار Git الذي يحتاجه GitTree؟ (2.39 أو أحدث)

promise.en: Check your Git version and read the two screens GitTree shows when Git is missing or too old.

concept: GitTree never bundles Git: it runs the git command you already have.

title.en: Sign in to GitTree on first launch (website account)
title.ar: تسجيل الدخول إلى GitTree عند أول تشغيل بحساب الموقع

promise.en: Sign in through the GitTree website from the app, including the manual code fallback.

concept: Your GitTree account (website) is separate from your Git identity and your hosting accounts.

title.en: Open a Git repository in GitTree (folder or drag and drop)
title.ar: فتح مستودع Git في GitTree (من مجلد أو بالسحب والإفلات)

promise.en: Open an existing repository from the New Tab page, the Open shortcut or a dropped folder.

concept: A repository is a working folder plus a .git directory.

title.en: Trust this repository? What GitTree checks before it opens
title.ar: هل تثق بهذا المستودع؟ ما يفحصه GitTree قبل فتحه

promise.en: Read the trust prompt and choose between Restricted Mode and Trust and Open.

concept: A cloned repository's config and hooks can run programs on your machine.

title.en: Clone a Git repository by URL in GitTree
title.ar: استنساخ مستودع Git من رابط في GitTree

promise.en: Clone a repository from a URL into a folder you choose and open it.

concept: A clone copies the full history and sets the remote named origin.

title.en: Create a new Git repository in GitTree (git init)
title.ar: إنشاء مستودع Git جديد في GitTree (git init)

promise.en: Initialise a new repository with a first branch name and an optional .gitignore template and licence.

concept: git init creates the object database and the first branch.

title.en: Recent repositories and the New Tab page in GitTree
title.ar: المستودعات الأخيرة وصفحة التبويب الجديد في GitTree

promise.en: Reopen a repository from the Recent list and remove one from it without deleting files.

concept: The recent list is stored by the app, nothing in the repository changes.

title.en: GitTree window tour: sidebar, graph, inspector, drawer
title.ar: جولة في نافذة GitTree: الشريط الجانبي والرسم واللوحة السفلية

promise.en: Learn where the four areas of the window are and how to toggle each one.

concept: The window is a view over one repository: refs on the left, history in the centre, details on the right.

title.en: What is a Git commit? See one in GitTree
title.ar: ما هو الـ commit في Git؟ شاهد واحدًا في GitTree

promise.en: See that a commit is a snapshot with a parent, a message and an author, using the Commit Details panel.

concept: A commit is a snapshot (tree) plus parents, message, author and committer.

title.en: The Git commit graph explained: history is a DAG
title.ar: شرح رسم الـ commits في Git: السجل شبكة موجَّهة

promise.en: Read the commit graph: parents, lanes and why history is a graph and not a line.

concept: History is a directed acyclic graph in which lanes show parallel lines of work.

title.en: Git branches are just pointers (refs explained)
title.ar: الفروع في Git مجرد مؤشّرات: شرح الـ refs

promise.en: See branch pills on the graph and learn that a ref is a movable name for a commit.

concept: A ref (branch name) is a movable pointer to a commit.

title.en: What is HEAD in Git? Find it in GitTree
title.ar: ما هو HEAD في Git؟ اعثر عليه في GitTree

promise.en: Jump to HEAD and see what the checked-out branch and a detached HEAD look like.

concept: HEAD is the current commit, usually through the checked-out branch.

title.en: Git working tree, index and HEAD: the three trees
title.ar: شجرة العمل والـ index وHEAD في Git: الأشجار الثلاث

promise.en: Use the Working Changes panel to see the working folder, the index and HEAD as three different states.

concept: Git compares three trees: the working tree, the index (staging area) and HEAD.

title.en: Local vs remote branches in Git (origin/main explained)
title.ar: الفروع المحلية والبعيدة في Git: شرح origin/main

promise.en: Read the left panel and the ahead and behind counts to tell local branches from remote-tracking ones.

concept: A remote-tracking branch is your local record of where the remote's branch was at the last fetch.

title.en: What is a Git remote? Add, edit and remove one
title.ar: ما هو الـ remote في Git؟ إضافة وتعديل وحذف

promise.en: Add, edit and remove a remote and see that it is only a name for a URL.

concept: A remote is a named URL (with an optional separate push URL).

title.en: Git tags explained: create a tag in GitTree
title.ar: شرح الـ tags في Git: أنشئ tag في GitTree

promise.en: Create a lightweight tag on a commit and see it as a pill in the graph.

concept: A lightweight tag is a fixed name on a commit.

title.en: Git fetch explained: download without changing your files
title.ar: شرح git fetch: تنزيل التحديثات دون تغيير ملفاتك

promise.en: Run Fetch All and watch only the remote-tracking branches move while your files stay put.

concept: Fetch updates remote-tracking refs and never touches your working files or your branches.

title.en: What is a Git fast-forward? Move a branch pointer
title.ar: ما هو الـ fast-forward في Git؟ تحريك مؤشر الفرع

promise.en: Fast-forward a branch to its upstream and see that only the pointer moves.

concept: A fast-forward moves a branch pointer along a straight line and creates no commit.

title.en: Git merge vs rebase: the difference on the graph
title.ar: الفرق بين git merge وgit rebase على الرسم

promise.en: Drag one branch onto another and compare what Merge and Rebase do to the graph.

concept: Merge joins two lines of history with a new commit; rebase replays commits with new ids.

title.en: Git config scopes: system, global and local explained
title.ar: نطاقات إعدادات Git: النظام والعام والمحلي

promise.en: Change a Git setting at the global and the local level from Preferences and see which one wins.

concept: Git settings live in scopes (system, global, local) and the narrowest scope wins.

title.en: Stage a file in GitTree (git add explained)
title.ar: كيف تُجهِّز ملفًا في GitTree (شرح git add)

promise.en: Stage one changed file so that it goes into the next commit and the others do not.

concept: Staging copies a file's changes into the index, which is the next commit.

title.en: Stage a single hunk in GitTree (commit part of a file)
title.ar: كيف تُجهِّز Hunk واحدًا في GitTree وتحفظ جزءًا من الملف

promise.en: Commit only one of two changes in the same file, without touching the other.
promise.ar: احفظ تعديلًا واحدًا من تعديلين في الملف نفسه دون المساس بالآخر.

concept: The staging area (index) decides what a commit contains; a hunk is the unit of a change.

title.en: Stage single lines in GitTree (partial commit)
title.ar: جهِّز أسطرًا محددة في GitTree لحفظ جزء من التعديل

promise.en: Pick individual changed lines and stage only those.

concept: A patch can be narrowed to single lines before it enters the index.
commands: git add -p (then e to edit the hunk)

title.en: Unstage a file in GitTree (undo git add)
title.ar: إلغاء تجهيز ملف في GitTree (التراجع عن git add)

promise.en: Move a staged file back to the unstaged list without losing any edit.

concept: Unstaging resets the index entry and leaves the file on disk untouched.

title.en: Make a Git commit in GitTree step by step
title.ar: كيف تُنشئ commit في GitTree خطوة بخطوة

promise.en: Write a summary and description and commit the staged changes.

concept: A commit snapshots the index, not the working folder.

title.en: Write better Git commit messages with GitTree hints
title.ar: اكتب رسائل commit أوضح مع تلميحات GitTree

promise.en: Use the summary counter and the message hints, including the Conventional Commits check.

concept: A commit message has a short summary, a blank line, then an optional body.

title.en: Amend the last Git commit in GitTree
title.ar: تعديل آخر commit في GitTree (amend)

promise.en: Fix the message or add a forgotten file to the last commit.

concept: Amend replaces the tip commit with a new one that has a new id.

title.en: Git commit options: sign-off, skip hooks, other author
title.ar: خيارات commit في Git: التوقيع وتخطي الـ hooks ومؤلف آخر

promise.en: Open the Commit Options menu and use sign-off, a different author and recent messages.

concept: A commit records an author and a committer separately, and can carry a sign-off trailer.

title.en: Add co-authors to a Git commit in GitTree
title.ar: إضافة مشاركين في التأليف إلى commit في GitTree

promise.en: Credit a second person on a commit with a Co-authored-by trailer.

concept: A trailer is a key and value line at the end of a commit message.

title.en: Git commit hooks: read pre-commit output in GitTree
title.ar: خطافات commit في Git: اقرأ مخرجات pre-commit في GitTree

promise.en: See what a failing pre-commit hook prints and why your message and staged changes are kept.

concept: A hook is a script in .git/hooks that can stop a commit.

title.en: Draft a Git commit message with your own AI agent CLI
title.ar: اكتب رسالة commit بمساعدة وكيل ذكاء اصطناعي تثبّته أنت

promise.en: Generate a commit message from the staged diff using a coding-agent CLI you installed and signed in to.

concept: The staged diff is the input to a message, and it is sent only when you click.

title.en: Discard changes to a file in GitTree (git restore)
title.ar: تجاهل تغييرات ملف في GitTree (git restore)

promise.en: Throw away the changes in one file, knowing a recovery snapshot is saved first.

concept: Discarding is irreversible in plain Git, so GitTree snapshots to a private ref before acting.

title.en: Discard a single hunk in GitTree (undo part of a file)
title.ar: تجاهل Hunk واحد في GitTree (التراجع عن جزء من الملف)

promise.en: Throw away one hunk of a file and keep the other.

concept: A hunk can be reverse-applied to the working tree on its own.

title.en: Discard all changes in a Git repository safely
title.ar: تجاهل كل التغييرات في مستودع Git بأمان

promise.en: Reset the whole working folder to the last commit with one confirmed action.

concept: Resetting the tree to HEAD removes both staged and unstaged work.

title.en: Ignore a file, folder or extension in Git (.gitignore)
title.ar: تجاهل ملف أو مجلد أو امتداد في Git (.gitignore)

promise.en: Add a path to .gitignore from the right-click menu.

concept: .gitignore tells Git which untracked files to leave out.

title.en: Edit .gitignore and find out why a file is ignored
title.ar: تعديل .gitignore ومعرفة سبب تجاهل ملف

promise.en: Edit .gitignore with a template and ask which rule ignores a given path.

concept: git check-ignore -v names the exact rule and file that ignores a path.

title.en: Git diff in GitTree: hunk, inline and side by side
title.ar: عرض git diff في GitTree: Hunk وInline وSplit

promise.en: Switch the diff between Hunk, Inline and Split views.

concept: A diff is added and removed lines shown with their context.

title.en: Jump between changes in a Git diff (F7 and Shift+F7)
title.ar: التنقل بين التغييرات في الـ diff بالمفتاحين F7 وShift+F7

promise.en: Move to the next and previous change with the keyboard and the change overview.

concept: Reading a long diff is faster when you jump from change to change.

title.en: Ignore whitespace in a Git diff and wrap long lines
title.ar: تجاهل المسافات البيضاء في الـ diff ولفّ الأسطر الطويلة

promise.en: Turn on Ignore whitespace, Wrap lines and Highlight changed words.

concept: Whitespace-only changes are noise that git diff -w removes.

title.en: Compare images in Git: side by side, swipe, onion skin
title.ar: مقارنة الصور في Git: جنبًا إلى جنب والسحب والتراكب

promise.en: Compare two versions of an image with the three image diff modes.

concept: Git stores binary files as blobs, so GitTree reads both blobs and compares them visually.

title.en: View a file at any Git commit in GitTree
title.ar: عرض ملف كما كان في أي commit في GitTree

promise.en: Open a file as it was at a chosen commit using File View.

concept: Every commit holds a complete snapshot, so any file can be read at any revision.

title.en: Compare two Git commits in GitTree (git diff A B)
title.ar: مقارنة commit مع آخر في GitTree (git diff A B)

promise.en: Select two commits and see the files that differ between them.

concept: A diff between two commits compares two snapshots, not two changes.

title.en: Restore a file from an old Git commit in GitTree
title.ar: استرجاع ملف من commit قديم في GitTree

promise.en: Bring one file back to how it was in a chosen commit.

concept: Restoring overwrites your work, so GitTree saves it in a recovery ref first.

title.en: Git blame: who changed this line? (GitTree blame view)
title.ar: git blame: من غيّر هذا السطر؟ (عرض blame في GitTree)

promise.en: Open Blame on a file and see which commit last touched each line.

concept: Blame attributes each line to the commit that last changed it.

title.en: Git blame before this commit: walk a line's history
title.ar: تتبّع تاريخ سطر بخطوات blame للخلف في GitTree

promise.en: Step back to the blame of the commit before the one that changed a line.

concept: Blaming at a commit's parent reveals who changed the line before.

title.en: Git file history with renames (git log --follow)
title.ar: تاريخ ملف في Git مع إعادة التسمية (git log --follow)

promise.en: List every commit that changed one file, across renames.

concept: File history can follow a file through renames.

title.en: The WIP row in the Git graph: your uncommitted work
title.ar: صف WIP في رسم Git: عملك الذي لم يُحفظ بعد

promise.en: Read the WIP row at the top of the graph and open the working changes from it.

concept: The working tree is the uncommitted tip of your history.

title.en: Search Git history in GitTree (Ctrl+F in the graph)
title.ar: البحث في سجل Git داخل GitTree (Ctrl+F في الرسم)

promise.en: Search the loaded history by message, author, SHA, branch or tag and jump between matches.

concept: Searching what is already loaded is instant, and it is limited to the loaded rows.

title.en: Git stash in GitTree: save work in progress
title.ar: git stash في GitTree: احفظ عملك غير المكتمل جانبًا

promise.en: Stash all your changes to get a clean working folder.

concept: A stash is a pair of commits on refs/stash that holds your uncommitted work.

title.en: Git stash pop in GitTree: bring your changes back
title.ar: git stash pop في GitTree: استرجع تغييراتك المخبّأة

promise.en: Pop the latest stash to restore it and remove it from the list.

concept: Pop applies a stash and drops it in one step.

title.en: Create a Git branch in GitTree
title.ar: إنشاء فرع جديد في Git عبر GitTree

promise.en: Create a branch at the current commit and check it out.

concept: Creating a branch writes a new pointer to a commit and nothing else.

title.en: Switch Git branches in GitTree (git switch)
title.ar: التبديل بين فروع Git في GitTree (git switch)

promise.en: Check out another branch, including what GitTree offers when local changes are in the way.

concept: Checkout moves HEAD, and local changes can block it.

title.en: Check out a remote Git branch and track it
title.ar: سحب فرع بعيد في Git وتتبّعه محليًا

promise.en: Check out a remote branch so that a local branch tracks it.

concept: A local branch can track a remote branch (its upstream).

title.en: Rename a Git branch in GitTree
title.ar: إعادة تسمية فرع في Git عبر GitTree

promise.en: Rename a local branch and see the pill change.

concept: Renaming moves a pointer's name, not its commits.

title.en: Delete a Git branch safely in GitTree
title.ar: حذف فرع في Git بأمان عبر GitTree

promise.en: Delete a local branch and see that its last commit is kept in a recovery ref.

concept: Deleting a branch removes the pointer; the commits stay reachable until they are cleaned up.

title.en: Set the upstream branch in Git (tracking explained)
title.ar: تحديد الفرع المتتبَّع (upstream) في Git: الشرح

promise.en: Choose which remote branch a local branch tracks, or make it track nothing.

concept: The upstream is the remote branch that pull, push and ahead and behind counts compare against.

title.en: Create an annotated Git tag in GitTree
title.ar: إنشاء tag موصوف (annotated) في Git عبر GitTree

promise.en: Create an annotated tag with a message for a release.

concept: An annotated tag is its own object with a message, unlike a lightweight tag.

title.en: Delete a Git tag locally and on the remote
title.ar: حذف tag في Git محليًا وعلى الخادم

promise.en: Delete a tag from your repository and, separately, from the remote.

concept: Deleting a remote tag affects everyone who fetches.

title.en: Preview a Git merge for conflicts before you merge
title.ar: معاينة الدمج في Git لمعرفة التعارضات قبل تنفيذه

promise.en: See whether a merge will conflict, and in which files, before anything changes.

concept: A merge can be predicted without touching your files.

title.en: Merge a Git branch in GitTree (merge commit)
title.ar: دمج فرع في Git عبر GitTree (merge commit)

promise.en: Merge one branch into the current branch and choose how it is recorded.

concept: A merge commit has two parents; a fast-forward has none to add.

title.en: Git squash merge: combine a branch into one commit
title.ar: الدمج بالضغط في Git (squash merge): فرع كامل في commit واحد

promise.en: Squash a branch into the staged changes and commit it as one commit.

concept: A squash merge copies a branch's changes without recording its history.

title.en: Git merge in progress: the operation banner in GitTree
title.ar: دمج Git قيد التنفيذ: شريط العملية في GitTree

promise.en: Read the operation banner and know when to Resolve, Continue, Skip or Abort.

concept: An unfinished operation is recorded in state files inside .git.

title.en: Abort a Git merge or rebase and go back to before
title.ar: إلغاء الدمج أو الـ rebase في Git والعودة لما قبله

promise.en: Abort an operation in one step and see that your work is kept under a recovery ref.

concept: An abort restores the state from before the operation started.

title.en: Merge conflicts in Git: find the conflicted files
title.ar: تعارضات الدمج في Git: اعثر على الملفات المتعارضة

promise.en: Read the Conflicted Files and Resolved Files lists and mark files resolved.

concept: A conflicted file has three versions in the index: base, ours and theirs.

title.en: Resolve a Git merge conflict in GitTree's merge view
title.ar: حل تعارض الدمج في Git داخل عرض الدمج في GitTree

promise.en: Resolve one conflict line by line in the three-pane editor and save it as resolved.

concept: Resolving a conflict means choosing the final content, then staging it.

title.en: Resolve a Git conflict by taking one whole side
title.ar: حل التعارض في Git بأخذ أحد الطرفين بالكامل

promise.en: Resolve a file by keeping ours or theirs entirely, including delete versus modify.

concept: --ours and --theirs pick a whole version of a conflicted file.

title.en: Use an external merge tool for Git conflicts
title.ar: استخدام أداة دمج خارجية لحل تعارضات Git

promise.en: Open a conflicted file in the merge tool you configured and return to GitTree.

concept: A merge tool is a program Git hands the base, local and remote versions to.

title.en: Git flow in GitTree: initialise the branching model
title.ar: Git flow في GitTree: تهيئة نموذج الفروع

promise.en: Initialise Gitflow with your production and development branches and prefixes.

concept: Gitflow is a naming and merging convention built on ordinary branches and merges.

title.en: Git flow: start and finish a feature branch
title.ar: Git flow: بدء فرع ميزة وإنهاؤه

promise.en: Start a feature, commit on it, and finish it back into develop.

concept: Finishing a Gitflow feature is a no-fast-forward merge followed by deleting the branch.

title.en: Predict Git merge conflicts before they happen
title.ar: توقّع تعارضات الدمج في Git قبل حدوثها

promise.en: Read the early conflict warning chip on a branch and the setting that controls it.

concept: Git can compute a merge result in memory without changing any file.

title.en: Git rebase explained: rebase a branch in GitTree
title.ar: شرح git rebase: إعادة تأسيس فرع في GitTree

promise.en: Rebase the current branch onto another and see the commits get new ids.

concept: Rebase replays your commits on a new base, creating new commits.

title.en: Git interactive rebase in GitTree (pick, squash, drop)
title.ar: الـ rebase التفاعلي في Git عبر GitTree (pick وsquash وdrop)

promise.en: Rearrange, combine and drop commits in the interactive rebase editor.

concept: An interactive rebase is a todo list of actions applied to a range of commits.

title.en: Change a Git commit message after committing (reword)
title.ar: تغيير رسالة commit بعد حفظه في Git (reword)

promise.en: Reword an older commit message from the graph.

concept: Changing any commit message gives that commit and every commit above it a new id.

title.en: Remove a commit from Git history (drop a commit)
title.ar: إزالة commit من سجل Git (drop)

promise.en: Drop a commit from the graph and see how Undo can bring it back.

concept: Dropping a commit removes it from the branch but not from the object database.

title.en: Reorder Git commits: move a commit up or down
title.ar: إعادة ترتيب الـ commits في Git: انقل commit لأعلى أو لأسفل

promise.en: Move a commit up or down in the history from the right-click menu.

concept: Reordering commits replays them in a new order, which can conflict.

title.en: Squash Git commits into one in GitTree
title.ar: دمج عدة commits في commit واحد في Git (squash)

promise.en: Select several commits and squash them into one.

concept: Squashing folds the changes of several commits into one commit.

title.en: Why rewriting pushed Git commits is risky
title.ar: لماذا إعادة كتابة commits مدفوعة في Git أمر خطير

promise.en: See the warning GitTree shows when commits you are about to rewrite are already on a remote.

concept: Rewriting shared history forces everyone else to reconcile it.

title.en: Git cherry-pick: copy a commit to another branch
title.ar: git cherry-pick: انسخ commit إلى فرع آخر

promise.en: Copy one commit onto the current branch.

concept: Cherry-pick re-applies a commit's change on top of HEAD as a new commit.

title.en: Git revert: undo a commit without rewriting history
title.ar: git revert: تراجع عن commit دون إعادة كتابة السجل

promise.en: Revert a commit by adding a new commit that undoes it.

concept: A revert is a new inverse commit, which is safe on shared history.

title.en: Git reset --soft: undo a commit but keep it staged
title.ar: git reset --soft: ألغِ commit مع إبقاء التغييرات مجهّزة

promise.en: Move the branch back one commit while the changes stay staged.

concept: A soft reset moves only the branch pointer.

title.en: Git reset --mixed: undo a commit, keep the changes
title.ar: git reset --mixed: ألغِ commit مع إبقاء التغييرات في المجلد

promise.en: Move the branch back and the index with it, keeping your files.

concept: A mixed reset moves the branch pointer and resets the index.

title.en: Git reset --hard in GitTree: discard commits safely
title.ar: git reset --hard في GitTree: تجاهل commits بأمان

promise.en: Hard-reset a branch and recover the discarded work from the snapshot GitTree takes first.

concept: A hard reset moves the branch, the index and the files, so it can lose work.

title.en: Undo and redo Git operations in GitTree
title.ar: التراجع عن عمليات Git وإعادتها في GitTree (Undo وRedo)

promise.en: Undo a rebase and a branch delete from the toolbar and redo them.

concept: Undo restores a ref from a journal entry, only if the ref has not moved since.

title.en: Git recovery snapshots: GitTree's refs/ogt/trash
title.ar: لقطات الاسترداد: refs/ogt/trash في GitTree

promise.en: Find the recovery snapshots GitTree keeps and delete the old ones.

concept: A snapshot is a commit kept alive under a private ref so nothing is lost.

title.en: Git reflog explained: see where HEAD has been
title.ar: شرح git reflog: أين كان HEAD من قبل

promise.en: Open the reflog of a branch and read the list of places it pointed to.

concept: The reflog is the local record of where each ref used to point.

title.en: Recover a lost Git commit with the reflog
title.ar: استرجاع commit ضائع في Git باستخدام reflog

promise.en: Create a branch from a reflog entry to get back a commit that no branch points to.

concept: A commit with no ref is still in the database until garbage collection.

title.en: Git bisect: find the commit that introduced a bug
title.ar: git bisect: اعثر على الـ commit الذي أدخل الخطأ

promise.en: Mark commits good and bad until GitTree names the first bad commit.

concept: Bisect is a binary search through history.

title.en: Create a Git patch file from a commit (format-patch)
title.ar: إنشاء ملف patch من commit في Git (format-patch)

promise.en: Save one or more commits as a patch file you can send.

concept: A patch file is a portable description of a commit.

title.en: Apply a Git patch file: git apply vs git am
title.ar: تطبيق ملف patch في Git: الفرق بين git apply وgit am

promise.en: Apply a patch to the working tree, to the index, or as commits.

concept: git apply changes files, while git am also creates the commits.

title.en: Git push in GitTree: send your commits to a remote
title.ar: git push في GitTree: أرسل commits إلى المستودع البعيد

promise.en: Push a branch, including the first push that picks the remote branch.

concept: A push sends commits and moves a ref on the remote.

title.en: Check where a Git push will go before you push
title.ar: تحقق من وجهة git push قبل الدفع

promise.en: Read the destination check and choose a different target if it is wrong.

concept: push.default and push remotes decide where a plain push lands.

title.en: Git pull --ff-only in GitTree
title.ar: git pull --ff-only في GitTree

promise.en: Pull with fast-forward only and see it refuse when histories have diverged.

concept: Pull is a fetch followed by an integration; fast-forward only refuses when branches diverged.

title.en: Git pull: fast-forward if possible, else merge
title.ar: git pull: تقدّم سريع إن أمكن وإلا دمج

promise.en: Pull when both sides have new commits and get a merge commit.

concept: Pull in merge mode ties your commits and the remote's with a merge commit.

title.en: Git pull --rebase in GitTree
title.ar: git pull --rebase في GitTree

promise.en: Pull by replaying your local commits on top of the remote's.

concept: Pull with rebase keeps a straight history by replaying local commits.

title.en: Choose your default Git pull mode in GitTree
title.ar: اختر طريقة git pull الافتراضية في GitTree

promise.en: Set what the toolbar Pull button does: fast-forward only, merge or rebase.

concept: The pull mode is a policy: how your branch takes in the remote's new commits.

title.en: Git push rejected (non-fast-forward): how to fix it
title.ar: رفض git push (non-fast-forward): كيف تحل المشكلة

promise.en: Understand the refused-push dialog and choose Fetch, Merge and Push or Rebase and Push.

concept: A push is refused when the remote has commits you do not have.

title.en: Git force push with lease: the safe way in GitTree
title.ar: الدفع القسري الآمن في Git (force push with lease)

promise.en: Force-push a rewritten branch so that it refuses if the remote moved.

concept: --force-with-lease overwrites the remote only if it still has the commit you last saw.

title.en: Delete a remote Git branch from GitTree
title.ar: حذف فرع بعيد في Git من GitTree

promise.en: Delete a branch on the remote without leaving GitTree.

concept: Deleting a remote branch pushes a deletion to the server.

title.en: Push a Git tag to the remote in GitTree
title.ar: دفع tag إلى المستودع البعيد في Git عبر GitTree

promise.en: Push a single tag to the remote.

concept: Tags are not pushed with a branch unless you ask for them.

title.en: Git auto-fetch: keep remote branches up to date
title.ar: الجلب التلقائي في Git: ابقَ على اطلاع بالفروع البعيدة

promise.en: Turn on auto-fetch with an interval and see why it never asks for credentials.

concept: A background fetch updates remote-tracking refs and never changes your files.

title.en: Connect GitHub to GitTree (browser sign-in or token)
title.ar: ربط GitHub بـ GitTree (تسجيل الدخول من المتصفح أو توكن)

promise.en: Connect a GitHub account with the browser device code or a personal access token.

concept: A hosting account lets the app talk to the host's API; the Git commands still use your credentials.

title.en: Connect GitHub Enterprise Server to GitTree
title.ar: ربط GitHub Enterprise Server بـ GitTree

promise.en: Name your Enterprise Server host and connect with a token or browser sign-in.

concept: A self-hosted host needs its own address and its own application ID.

title.en: Connect GitLab to GitTree (token or application ID)
title.ar: ربط GitLab بـ GitTree (توكن أو معرّف تطبيق)

promise.en: Connect gitlab.com or a self-managed GitLab with a token or a typed OAuth application ID.

concept: Not every host offers one-click browser sign-in, so a personal access token is the fallback.

title.en: Connect Bitbucket Cloud to GitTree
title.ar: ربط Bitbucket Cloud بـ GitTree

promise.en: Connect Bitbucket Cloud with browser sign-in, an API token or an access token.

concept: Some hosts sign you in through an authorization code and an account service.

title.en: Connect Azure DevOps to GitTree (personal access token)
title.ar: ربط Azure DevOps بـ GitTree (توكن وصول شخصي)

promise.en: Connect Azure DevOps with a personal access token.

concept: A personal access token is a password scoped to what you allow.

title.en: Connect Bitbucket Data Center to GitTree
title.ar: ربط Bitbucket Data Center بـ GitTree

promise.en: Connect a Bitbucket Data Center host through your administrator's OAuth application link.

concept: A self-hosted server needs an administrator-created application link before browser sign-in works.

title.en: Clone a repository from your hosting account in GitTree
title.ar: استنساخ مستودع من حسابك على المنصة داخل GitTree

promise.en: Browse the repositories of a connected account and clone one.

concept: The account only lists repositories; the clone itself is plain git over HTTPS.

title.en: Publish a local Git repository to a host from GitTree
title.ar: نشر مستودع Git محلي على منصة استضافة من GitTree

promise.en: Create the repository on your host, add it as origin and push, in one dialog.

concept: Publishing is three steps in one: create the remote repository, add origin, push.

title.en: Create a pull request from GitTree
title.ar: إنشاء pull request من GitTree

promise.en: Push a branch and start a pull request with a title and description, as a draft if you like.

concept: A pull request is a host feature that proposes merging one branch into another.

title.en: Check out a pull request branch locally in GitTree
title.ar: سحب فرع pull request محليًا في GitTree

promise.en: Fetch a pull request head and check out its branch.

concept: A host publishes each pull request head as a ref you can fetch.

title.en: Review pull request files and diffs in GitTree
title.ar: مراجعة ملفات pull request وتغييراتها في GitTree

promise.en: Read the changed files of a pull request.

concept: A pull request diff is the difference between the branch and its merge base.

title.en: Comment on and resolve pull request threads in GitTree
title.ar: التعليق على نقاشات pull request وإغلاقها في GitTree

promise.en: Post a comment, reply to a thread and resolve it.

concept: Review comments belong to lines and threads, and a thread can be resolved.

title.en: See pull request checks and re-run them in GitTree
title.ar: عرض فحوصات pull request وإعادة تشغيلها في GitTree

promise.en: Read the checks of a pull request and re-run a failed one.

concept: Checks are automated results the host attaches to a commit.

title.en: Review a pull request: approve or request changes
title.ar: مراجعة pull request: الموافقة أو طلب تعديلات

promise.en: Submit a review on a pull request and edit its details.

concept: A review is a verdict plus comments from a person other than the author.

title.en: Merge a pull request: merge, squash or rebase
title.ar: دمج pull request: دمج عادي أو squash أو rebase

promise.en: Merge a pull request on the host with the method you choose.

concept: The host merges server-side, guarded by the expected head commit.

title.en: See issues and start a branch from one in GitTree
title.ar: عرض الـ issues وبدء فرع منها في GitTree

promise.en: Open an issue from the sidebar and create a branch for it.

concept: An issue is a host record; the branch is plain Git.

title.en: Create an issue from GitTree
title.ar: إنشاء issue من GitTree

promise.en: Create a new issue with a title and a Markdown description.

concept: Creating an issue is a call to the host's API, not a Git operation.

title.en: Git fork workflow: add a remote from a fork in GitTree
title.ar: العمل مع fork في Git: إضافة remote من fork في GitTree

promise.en: Add a remote that points to someone's fork over HTTPS or SSH.

concept: A fork workflow uses several remotes, typically origin and upstream.

title.en: Git worktrees explained: see them in GitTree
title.ar: شرح git worktree: مجلدات عمل متعددة لمستودع واحد

promise.en: Find the Worktrees section and understand what several working folders share.

concept: A worktree is another working folder that shares the same object database.

title.en: Create a Git worktree in GitTree (git worktree add)
title.ar: إنشاء worktree في Git عبر GitTree (git worktree add)

promise.en: Create a worktree for a branch or a new branch in a separate folder.

concept: A branch can be checked out in only one worktree at a time.

title.en: Move, lock and remove a Git worktree
title.ar: نقل وقفل وحذف worktree في Git

promise.en: Move, lock, remove and prune worktrees safely.

concept: Git tracks worktrees in the main repository, so moving one by hand breaks the link.

title.en: Git submodules explained: see them in GitTree
title.ar: شرح git submodule: عرضها في GitTree

promise.en: Read the Submodules section and its states.

concept: A submodule pins another repository at one exact commit.

title.en: Add a Git submodule in GitTree
title.ar: إضافة submodule في Git عبر GitTree

promise.en: Add a submodule at a path, optionally following a branch.

concept: Adding a submodule records a .gitmodules entry and a pinned commit.

title.en: Update and remove a Git submodule in GitTree
title.ar: تحديث وحذف submodule في Git عبر GitTree

promise.en: Initialise, update, sync and remove a submodule.

concept: Updating a submodule checks out the commit the parent repository records.

title.en: Set up Git LFS for a repository in GitTree
title.ar: إعداد Git LFS لمستودع في GitTree

promise.en: Check that Git LFS is installed and set it up for this repository.

concept: Large files live outside the repository and pointer files live inside.

title.en: Track large files with Git LFS in GitTree
title.ar: تتبّع الملفات الكبيرة باستخدام Git LFS في GitTree

promise.en: Track and untrack a file pattern with LFS.

concept: Tracking writes a pattern into .gitattributes.

title.en: Download and prune Git LFS content in GitTree
title.ar: تنزيل محتوى Git LFS وتنظيفه في GitTree

promise.en: Download LFS file content and prune old content.

concept: An LFS pointer is replaced by the real file only when the content is downloaded.

title.en: Git LFS file locking in GitTree
title.ar: قفل الملفات في Git LFS داخل GitTree

promise.en: Lock and unlock a lockable file and see who holds a lock.

concept: A lock stops others editing a binary file that cannot be merged.

title.en: Git sparse checkout in GitTree: only the folders you need
title.ar: الـ sparse checkout في Git: اسحب المجلدات التي تحتاجها فقط

promise.en: Check out only chosen folders of a large repository, and bring everything back later.

concept: Cone-mode sparse checkout limits the working tree to selected directories.

title.en: Shallow, sparse and blobless Git clones in GitTree
title.ar: الاستنساخ السطحي والجزئي وبلا blobs في Git عبر GitTree

promise.en: Clone a big repository faster with depth, sparse or blobless options, and fetch more history later.

concept: Shallow, partial and sparse clones trade completeness for speed.

title.en: Git stash options: untracked files, staged only, message
title.ar: خيارات git stash: ملفات غير متتبَّعة ومجهّزة فقط ورسالة

promise.en: Stash with a message, include untracked files or stash only the staged changes.

concept: git stash push can limit what it saves and what it leaves behind.

title.en: Create a Git branch from a stash in GitTree
title.ar: إنشاء فرع من stash في Git عبر GitTree

promise.en: Turn an old stash into a branch.

concept: A stash is a commit, so it can become a branch.

title.en: Delete a Git stash and recover it from the snapshots
title.ar: حذف stash في Git واسترجاعه من لقطات الاسترداد

promise.en: Delete a stash and see that it is kept in the recovery snapshots.

concept: Dropping a stash normally loses its commit, so GitTree keeps a recovery ref.

title.en: Git repository maintenance in GitTree (fsck, gc)
title.ar: صيانة مستودع Git في GitTree (fsck وgc وcommit-graph)

promise.en: Check integrity, speed up history and clean up the object database.

concept: Git needs occasional housekeeping of its object database.

title.en: Group repositories into workspaces in GitTree
title.ar: تجميع المستودعات في مساحات عمل داخل GitTree

promise.en: Create a workspace, add repositories to it and open them all.

concept: A workspace is an app-level grouping; it is not a Git feature.

title.en: Work in several repositories with tabs in GitTree
title.ar: العمل على عدة مستودعات بالتبويبات في GitTree

promise.en: Open, switch, reorder and close repository tabs.

concept: Each tab is an independent session of one repository.

title.en: The GitTree command palette: run anything from the keyboard
title.ar: لوحة الأوامر في GitTree: نفّذ أي أمر من لوحة المفاتيح

promise.en: Open the palette and run commands, jump to refs and switch repositories with the prefixes.

concept: One searchable list replaces menus for commands, refs and repositories.

title.en: Search all Git history by message, author, file or change
title.ar: ابحث في كل سجل Git بالرسالة أو المؤلف أو الملف أو التغيير

promise.en: Search every commit with the # mode and the author, file and change filters.

concept: git log can search all of history without loading it into the graph.

title.en: Find any file fast in GitTree (fuzzy file finder)
title.ar: اعثر على أي ملف بسرعة في GitTree (البحث الضبابي)

promise.en: Find a file with the : mode and open its history.

concept: git ls-files lists tracked and untracked-but-not-ignored paths.

title.en: The integrated terminal in GitTree
title.ar: الطرفية المدمجة في GitTree

promise.en: Open a terminal in the repository folder, add more terminals and rename them.

concept: The terminal is a real shell opened at the repository root.

title.en: Define custom commands in GitTree (programs with tokens)
title.ar: تعريف أوامر مخصصة في GitTree (برامج مع متغيّرات)

promise.en: Add a custom command that runs a program with the repository, branch, SHA or file as arguments.

concept: A custom command is a program plus arguments, with no shell involved.

title.en: Run a custom command from the GitTree toolbar
title.ar: تشغيل أمر مخصص من شريط أدوات GitTree

promise.en: Run a saved custom command and read its confirmation and output.

concept: Running arbitrary programs needs an explicit confirmation.

title.en: Filter the Git graph by author, date, branch or path
title.ar: تصفية رسم Git حسب المؤلف والتاريخ والفرع والمسار

promise.en: Show only the commits that match a filter and clear it again.

concept: git log can restrict history by author, dates and paths over chosen starting points.

title.en: See all your pull requests across a workspace
title.ar: اعرض كل طلبات الدمج الخاصة بك عبر مساحة العمل

promise.en: Use the Pull requests tab of the Workspaces page to see what needs your review.

concept: A dashboard is a view over the host's API across many repositories.

title.en: GitTree Preferences: search, scopes and reset
title.ar: تفضيلات GitTree: البحث والنطاقات وإعادة الضبط

promise.en: Find a setting with search, see where it is saved, and reset it.

concept: Every setting has an origin: built-in default, app, profile, repository or Git config.

title.en: Change the GitTree theme: dark, light, high contrast
title.ar: تغيير مظهر GitTree: داكن وفاتح وتباين عالٍ

promise.en: Choose a theme, or follow the system appearance.

concept: Themes only change colours, never Git data.

title.en: Change the GitTree language: English and Arabic (RTL)
title.ar: تغيير لغة GitTree: العربية والإنجليزية (من اليمين لليسار)

promise.en: Switch the app between English and Arabic and see the layout mirror.

concept: Right-to-left layout mirrors the interface, not your repository.

title.en: Zoom, date format and reduced motion in GitTree
title.ar: التكبير وصيغة التاريخ وتقليل الحركة في GitTree

promise.en: Zoom the interface, choose a date format and show or hide sidebar sections.

concept: Display preferences change how the same history is shown.

title.en: Git profiles in GitTree: work and personal identities
title.ar: ملفات التعريف في GitTree: هوية للعمل وأخرى شخصية

promise.en: Create two profiles with different names and emails and switch between them.

concept: user.name and user.email decide who a commit says it is from.

title.en: SSH keys in GitTree: generate, copy and test
title.ar: مفاتيح SSH في GitTree: التوليد والنسخ والاختبار

promise.en: Generate an Ed25519 key, copy its public half and test a connection.

concept: An SSH key pair proves who you are without a password.

title.en: SSH host key and username prompts in GitTree
title.ar: تنبيهات مفتاح المضيف واسم المستخدم لـ SSH في GitTree

promise.en: Answer the 'Connect to host?' prompt safely and choose how unknown host keys are treated.

concept: The first SSH connection to a server asks you to trust its host key.

title.en: Sign Git commits in GitTree (OpenPGP, SSH, S/MIME)
title.ar: توقيع commits في Git عبر GitTree (OpenPGP وSSH وS/MIME)

promise.en: Choose a signing key and turn on signing for every commit.

concept: A signed commit proves who created it.

title.en: Set an external diff tool, merge tool and editor
title.ar: ضبط أداة مقارنة وأداة دمج ومحرر خارجي في GitTree

promise.en: Pick the diff tool, merge tool and editor GitTree opens for you.

concept: Diff and merge tools are programs Git hands file versions to.

title.en: GitTree keyboard shortcuts: the cheat sheet
title.ar: اختصارات لوحة المفاتيح في GitTree: ورقة الاختصارات

promise.en: Open the Keyboard Shortcuts sheet and find the shortcut for any command.

concept: Shortcuts are bindings from key chords to command ids.

title.en: Customise keyboard shortcuts in GitTree
title.ar: تخصيص اختصارات لوحة المفاتيح في GitTree

promise.en: Change, remove and reset a shortcut and see how conflicts are reported.

concept: Two commands cannot share one chord in the same context.

title.en: See the exact Git commands GitTree runs (Activity Log)
title.ar: اعرف أوامر Git التي ينفّذها GitTree بالضبط (سجل النشاط)

promise.en: Open the Activity Log to read each git command, its output and its result.

concept: Everything the app does is a plain git command you can read and repeat.

title.en: Report a bug or a crash from GitTree
title.ar: الإبلاغ عن خطأ أو انهيار من داخل GitTree

promise.en: Open Crash Reports, copy the text and report it on GitHub.

concept: A useful bug report names the version, the steps and the log, with no secrets.

title.en: Update GitTree: check for updates, download and install
title.ar: تحديث GitTree: التحقق من التحديثات وتنزيلها وتثبيتها

promise.en: Check for an update, see the download get verified and restart to install it.

concept: The app verifies a download by SHA-256 against the published release.

title.en: GitTree startup screens: update, offline, maintenance
title.ar: شاشات بدء GitTree: تحديث مطلوب وبلا اتصال وصيانة

promise.en: Understand each startup gate screen and what to do on each, including the 7-day offline grace.

concept: The official build checks a release gate at launch and works offline for a limited time.

title.en: Sign out of GitTree everywhere
title.ar: تسجيل الخروج من GitTree على كل الأجهزة

promise.en: Sign out of your GitTree account and see that connected hosting accounts stay connected.

concept: Your GitTree account and your hosting accounts are separate.

title.en: Restricted mode in GitTree: open untrusted repos safely
title.ar: الوضع المقيَّد في GitTree: تصفّح مستودعًا غير موثوق بأمان

promise.en: Work in Restricted Mode and review the trust decision later.

concept: An untrusted repository's configuration and hooks must not run.

title.en: Where GitTree stores your tokens (system keychain)
title.ar: أين يخزّن GitTree التوكنات الخاصة بك (مخزن مفاتيح النظام)

promise.en: See that tokens go to the system keychain and how to disconnect an account or forget all credentials.

concept: Credentials belong in the operating system's secure store, never in a file or a URL.

title.en: Linux keyring for GitTree: Secret Service setup
title.ar: مخزن المفاتيح على لينكس لـ GitTree: إعداد Secret Service

promise.en: Make sure a Secret Service (GNOME Keyring or KeePassXC) is running so GitTree can save tokens.

concept: On Linux the freedesktop Secret Service is the system keychain.

title.en: Import a custom theme into GitTree
title.ar: استيراد مظهر مخصص إلى GitTree

promise.en: Import a theme file and use it next to the built-in themes.

concept: A theme is data that GitTree reads, not code it runs.

title.en: Export, import and reset GitTree settings
title.ar: تصدير إعدادات GitTree واستيرادها وإعادة ضبطها

promise.en: Export your settings, import them on another computer and reset everything if needed.

concept: Settings are portable data; some Git settings write to your global config only after you confirm.
